project_type: Academic/Research - Jupyter notebooks for water quality classification using NGBoost + DiCE
build_system: None - Jupyter notebooks designed for Google Colab execution
test_framework: No automated tests - validation is structural (valid JSON/ipynb format) and code cell syntax correctness
test_command: python3 -c "import json, ast; nb1=json.load(open('NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb')); nb2=json.load(open('NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Kadiwal_Final_V2.ipynb')); [ast.parse(''.join(c['source'])) for c in nb1['cells'] if c['cell_type']=='code']; [ast.parse(''.join(c['source'])) for c in nb2['cells'] if c['cell_type']=='code']; print('All code cells parse successfully')"
verification_instructions: 1. Validate both V2 ipynb files are valid JSON. 2. Validate all code cells parse as valid Python (ast.parse). 3. Check that preprocessing order is Impute->Scale->Split (not Split->Impute->Scale). 4. Check that SMOTE-ENN conditional comparison exists. 5. Check Grid Search + 5-fold CV hyperparameter tuning exists. 6. Check DiCE sections exist with proper constraints.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - output is .ipynb files that will be executed on Google Colab
environment_constraints: Output must be valid .ipynb JSON files. Cannot execute notebooks (no pandas/sklearn installed). Validation is structural only.
contribution_requirements: Notebooks must be self-contained and runnable on Google Colab. Include pip install cells. Maintain Google Drive mounting with local fallback.
key_patterns: V1 notebooks use: markdown header cells with context, code cells with section separators (===), figures/ directory for saved plots, Google Drive mount with fallback, NGBoostWrapper pattern for DiCE compatibility, permitted_range for constraints
directory_structure: Flat repository: .ipynb notebooks, .csv datasets, .pdf papers, .docx proposal documents, .py build scripts. No src/ or tests/ directories.
